adapter.description: Design-system adapter in use. Determines component locations, token naming and story templates.

aliases.description: Path alias → source dir, used to derive import statements from story paths.

staticDir.description: Built Storybook directory, used when the dev server is not running.

dtcg.description: Canonical DTCG token file (source of truth on the code side).

cssOutput.description: CSS file that receives the generated managed region (shadcn: src/index.css).

stripGroups.description: Leading path groups dropped when deriving CSS variable names (color/primary → --primary).

prefix.description: Prefix added to every generated CSS variable name.

rename.description: Full token path → CSS variable name overrides, e.g. {"radius/base": "radius"}.

modeSelectors.description: Mode name → CSS selector. Unlisted modes become [data-theme="<mode>"].

fileKey.description: Default Figma file key for the design-system library.

codeConnect.description: auto = detect plan with whoami; on = always publish; off = local figma-map only.

visualDiffThreshold.description: Max fraction of differing pixels between story and Figma screenshots.

allowFiles.description: Globs where raw values are acceptable (vendored sources, token outputs).
